confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sicilian pricing, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July peak-season rates including city tourist tax. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA overview page, not from the page content itself, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized southern Italian tourist cities such as Palermo and Syracuse, adjusted for Catania's lower hotel prices than Taormina and its July demand from Etna and coastal visitors.
